changes: apps/agent-runtime/src/application/shortlist.ts — ShortlistSource becomes ApplicationDecisionSource and match() becomes decisionFor(), returning a discriminated DecisionOutcome (decision | blocked | unavailable with reason not_applicable | no_profile | not_configured | no_decision) instead of a nullable decision. The adapter no longer throws for a missing query; it reports not_configured.

apps/agent-runtime/src/application/service.ts — shortlistForVacancy maps the outcome to the shortlist policy (blocked -> empty list, not_configured -> 503 shortlist_unavailable, other unavailable reasons -> skip the submission, decision -> rank it), and the option, field and import are renamed.

apps/agent-runtime/src/application/__tests__/shortlist.test.ts — the seam-level assertion for a missing profile row now expects { kind: unavailable, reason: no_profile }; two consumer-policy tests were added (not_configured still yields 503; no_profile still yields an empty list), and the mock type and payloads follow the new interface.
apps/agent-runtime/src/application/__tests__/shortlist-auditor.test.ts and __tests__/draft-employer-org.test.ts — follow the rename and the discriminated union.
